title: Derived tensor with a scalar-restricted sheaf on a ringed site
statement:
Let $\mathcal C$ be a site small relative to the universe of module sheaves [def-weil-size-convention], and let $\varphi:\mathcal R\to\mathcal S$ be a morphism of sheaves of commutative rings. Use module sheaves [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], their unbounded derived categories [def-weil-abstract-derived-category], sheaf tensor and extension of scalars [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product], termwise restriction of scalars $\operatorname{Res}_\varphi$ [def-pc-sheaf-restrict-scalars], and derived tensor as obtained by the K-flat localization [lem-weil-pbc-site-derived-tensor-descent]. For every $H\in D(\mathcal R)$ and every sheaf $N$ of $\mathcal S$-modules placed in degree zero, there is an isomorphism in $D(\mathcal R)$, natural in both $H$ and $N$,
$$H\otimes_{\mathcal R}^{\mathbf L}\operatorname{Res}_\varphi N\xrightarrow{\sim}\operatorname{Res}_\varphi\bigl((H\otimes_{\mathcal R}^{\mathbf L}\mathcal S)\otimes_{\mathcal S}^{\mathbf L}N\bigr).$$
Here the inner extension is valued in $D(\mathcal S)$ as in [lem-pur-derived-change-of-rings]. For any K-flat flat-term representative $P\to H$ [def-pc-kflat-complex, def-pc-flat-sheaf-modules], the displayed isomorphism is represented by the balanced chain isomorphism
$$P\otimes_{\mathcal R}\operatorname{Res}_\varphi N\longrightarrow\operatorname{Res}_\varphi((P\otimes_{\mathcal R}\mathcal S)\otimes_{\mathcal S}N),\qquad x\otimes n\longmapsto(x\otimes1)\otimes n,$$
whose inverse sends $(x\otimes s)\otimes n$ to $x\otimes sn$. These representatives compute both derived objects and give the same natural isomorphism independently of the chosen representative. No flatness of $\mathcal S$ over $\mathcal R$, boundedness of $H$, or finite Tor amplitude of $N$ is assumed.
